title: Tessellate — Wallpaper Studio
description: Draw one motif, pick a wallpaper symmetry group, and a seamless pattern builds itself — export the tile, the wallpaper, or a link.
concept: Tessellate is a pattern design tool built on the crystallographic wallpaper groups. You draw inside a single fundamental cell with four brushes; every mark is instantly repeated through the group's full symmetry orbit (computed by closure over its generators) and wrapped across the cell edges, so the tiling is always seamless. Twelve groups from p1 to p4m, six palettes that recolour the whole pattern on the spot, a live zoomable wallpaper preview, four save slots, share links, and PNG export for both the tile and a 1920×1080 wallpaper.
features: 12 wallpaper symmetry groups (p1, p2, pm, pg, cm, pmm, pmg, pgg, cmm, p4, p4m, p4g) with orbits derived by group closure
Four brushes — ink, taper, calligraphic nib, and soft bloom — with a stroke-width slider
Six palettes that recolour every existing stroke instantly, plus a live zoom and cell-grid overlay
Surprise-me motif generator, undo, and four localStorage save slots with thumbnails
Export a seamless 1024px tile PNG, a 1920×1080 wallpaper PNG, or a share link that encodes the whole pattern in the URL

interaction.mouse: Drag inside the motif cell to draw; every stroke is mirrored and rotated by the active group
interaction.click: Pick a symmetry group, brush, ink colour or palette; export the tile, wallpaper or share link
interaction.touch: Draw with a finger in the cell; the wallpaper preview and controls stack vertically on phones
interaction.keyboard: 1–4 brushes · [ ] width · G next group · P next palette · R surprise · Z undo
